commit.message:
feat(post): waterjet records, CR LF, travel, programBounds and a generic waterjet post

The post engine gets the seams an abrasive-waterjet dialect needs:

- a lineEnding manifest entry ("lf" or "crlf"), read after onClose;
- machine.travel, the stated linear strokes, through the mirror and the
  raw door;
- programBounds, the XY box of the cutting records, before onOpen;
- WATERJET / JET stream records (cl::WaterjetCut, cl::JetSpan) with
  onJetOn / onJetOff and a JetLaw of their own, apart from the plasma
  TorchLaw;
- linearizeArcs / chordTolerance: arcs posted as chords from
  Move::segments3, one record per arc in the line map.

assets/posts/waterjet-iso.cps is a generic ISO abrasive-waterjet post
(XY only, water and abrasive M numbers as declared options, G4 valve
lag and pierce dwell, G2/G3 or chords, LF or CR LF). It refuses by name
spindle words (S, G95, G96), sections with no WATERJET header,
non-waterjet machines, rotaries, cycles, Z cuts and cuts outside the
stated travel.

Pinned by waterjet_engine.rs, waterjet_iso_post.rs (goldens plate.nc,
plate_inch_chords.nc), script_waterjet_iso.rs and the cl jet unit tests.

Fixes #1882

fix(post): keep a small positive waterjet feed or refuse it

The metric feed formatter rounded to whole mm/min, so a stated 0.1 mm/min
posted as F0. Feeds now keep three decimals in mm/min and two in in/min
(a whole feed stays whole, the goldens do not move). A positive feed that
still rounds to F0 is refused by name.

Pinned by waterjet_post_keeps_a_small_positive_feed_or_refuses_it.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(post): write waterjet header notes as one clean comment

Main's #2996 header notes reach every shipped post through onComment.
The waterjet post had none, so the PRELUDE default wrote a note raw: a
hostile model name could put live words on the line. The post now
writes the note as one parenthesis comment through commentText, like
the plasma and wire posts. The shipped-post walk now counts 20 posts
and gives the waterjet post a waterjet machine.

Pinned by header_notes_use_each_shipped_dialect_and_keep_the_full_surface_bound.

fix(post): refuse a waterjet section with no header after a section end

The engine now publishes the section's properties before onSection, so
the hook never reads a WATERJET header that the previous ENDSECTION
cleared. The waterjet post refuses a jet word or a cut with no header
by name in jetOk, never drops it without a warning.

Pinned by waterjet_post_refuses_an_adjacent_section_with_no_header.

fix(post): waterjet arc guard and reserved pockets for JET records

Review of PR #3046 on head 9d5db9bec.

- waterjet-iso.cps: onCircular reads arcFate (#3442, #3474). An arc
  whose written ends coincide is no block. A same-angle short arc is
  the straight move. The post no longer writes a full-circle block
  for a short arc with the jet on.
- reservations::check_stream: a JET record is cutting (the TORCH arm).
  A WATERJET header is no motion (the PLASMA arm). The tree compiles
  with main's #3284 again.
